ruleDefinitions.name: Possible DC Shadow Attack
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects DCShadow via create new SPN Note: Unmapped fields: ServicePrincipalNames, AttributeLDAPDisplayName, AttributeValue

sequences.query: ((event_id = 4742 AND ServicePrincipalNames = RGX(".*GC\\/.*")) OR (event_id = 5136 AND AttributeLDAPDisplayName = "servicePrincipalName" AND AttributeValue = RGX("^GC\\/")))
